snippet.title: Knob - Demo gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into an exciting 3D platforming adventure! Overcome tricky obstacles, solve creative puzzles, and defeat mechanical enemies. Master the unique movement of your ball-shaped hero.
You are awakened by a strange voice and must find out what it is all about.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WISHLIST now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478130/Knob/
Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579660/Knob_Demo/
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
